TRAITS

Every species in drop 1 has its own traits. Every hatch rolls them, so every daemon is one of a kind, and you name it.

Each species has six colour families (the first is the most common, the last the rarest), its own markings, proportions that change its shape, and three rare extras (about 1 in 20 to 1 in 33 each). Also for every species: one odd-coloured eye (1 in 50) and a fidgety temperament that moves twice as fast (3 in 10). Traits read as flags; rare extras are in yellow. Under each: in green, what the status line shows in its eight cells (a rare extra shows there too; colour and markings cannot, since the bar keeps its own colour), then how rare the combination is. Six per species, picked to show the range.
